description: Interface definition for the Perception Engine
purpose: Determines player-specific perception of the world based on cosmic state, attunement, alignment, and narrative memory

inputs.name: player_state
inputs.description: Full player state including attunement, alignment, bloodline, and memory

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: truth_substrate_ref
inputs.description: WorldTruthReference required by ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: perception_overlay
outputs.description: Player-specific overlay for the current location

outputs.name: perception_state_record
outputs.description: PerceptionStateRecord emitted under ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: overlay_manifest
outputs.description: OverlayManifest emitted under ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: visibility_rules
outputs.description: VisibilityRules emitted under ASH remediation contract.

methods.name: calculate_perception
methods.description: Calculate the perception overlay for a player at a given location

methods.name: get_visible_entities
methods.description: Determine which entities are visible to this player based on their perception state

methods.name: get_npc_variants
methods.description: Get the player-specific NPC variants for a location

methods.name: compose_overlay_manifest
methods.description: Compose OverlayManifest from ASH provenance and player perception state.

methods.name: validate_no_world_truth_rewrite
methods.description: Reject geography_rewrite and other shared-world edits from perception overlays.

invariants: The world itself does not change -- only player perception changes
Multiple players can perceive the same location differently
Perception derives from cosmic state, never arbitrary
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

ash_remediation_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_remediation_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
